name: XFORMAL
description: We take the first step towards multilingual style transfer by creating and releasing XFORMAL, a benchmark of multiple formal reformulations of informal text in Brazilian Portuguese, French, and Italian. Results on XFORMAL suggest that state-of-the-art style transfer approaches perform close to simple baselines, indicating that style transfer is even more challenging when moving multilingual.
reputation: A recent multilingual style-transfer dataset with limited but growing adoption among style-transfer and multilingual NLP researchers.
notes: Relatively small multilingual splits; automatic metrics (e.g., BLEU) correlate imperfectly with style change and fluency so human evaluation is required; risk of low cross-lingual transfer performance; not a saturation benchmark.
